periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated vertical axis, approximately a 1.7:1 ratio of length to width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering where the inferior margin extends further from the geometric center toward the rostrum.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve profile at the posterior boundary of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness, representing approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between pinnae, with a gap approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semicircular curvature with a smooth, rounded apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Notable brownish-red/rufous pigmentation staining on the fur in the ventral-pelvic region.
